content.short: Rubicon is an order book protocol on Ethereum L2 networks.
content.description: Rubicon is an on-chain order book protocol designed for trading ERC-20 tokens. It supports exchanging assets through swaps and supports a diverse set of order types, including limit orders, market orders, and batch orders, all within a decentralized exchange built around an on-chain order book. By delivering transparent price discovery and programmable order functionality, Rubicon enables flexible, non-custodial trading for ERC-20 token markets on the blockchain.
